The '''Thermal well''' was a sabotage and demolition device created for [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. It used [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] mixed with [[ytterbium]] to produce a more stabilized device that would ignite when energized rather than explode. The resulting thermal reaction could melt through five meters of [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] in a matter of seconds.
